newsitem.title: ITALY: Telecom Italia signs Israeli phone deal.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Italia signs Israeli phone deal.

text.p: Italian phone operator Telecom Italia said on Wednesday it had signed a shareholders' agreement with Israeli companies with which it is already a partner in the Golden Lines telecoms venture, to set up a new group, MED-1.

It said in a statement the company would will seek to improve telecommunications between Italy and Israel to keep up with increasing demand by laying some 2,400 km of sub-sea fibre optic cables between Mazara del Vallo in Italy and Tel Aviv.
Telecom Italia said an investment in the order of $80 million was foreseen, but gave no further details.
It said it expected the new service to start operation in August 1998.
